name: StaggeredGridReveal
description: Reusable responsive grid orchestrator that reveals cells across linear, diagonal-wave, or radial-center stagger patterns with replay and static fallback support.
a11yNotes: Preserves natural DOM tab order across grid cells regardless of visual stagger pattern and renders cells immediately when prefers-reduced-motion is active.

propsApi.name: pattern
propsApi.description: Spatial delay calculation mode across grid coordinates.

propsApi.name: columns
propsApi.description: Number of grid columns on desktop.

propsApi.name: duration
propsApi.description: Transition duration per cell in seconds.
